expected: Room Rent is up to 2% of the Sum Insured subject to a maximum of Rs 5,000 per day.
ICU/ICCU charges are up to 5% of the Sum Insured subject to a maximum of Rs 10,000 per day.
Cataract treatment is covered up to 25% of the Sum Insured or Rs 40,000, whichever is lower, per eye, under one policy year.
Pre-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 30 days prior to hospitalisation.
Post-hospitalisation expenses are covered for 60 days from the date of discharge.
The waiting period for pre-existing diseases is 36 months.
The standard co-payment is 5% of the admissible/payable claim amount, unless a risk-based co-payment in the policy schedule overrides it.
Hospitalisation expenses require a minimum of 24 consecutive hours, except for day care treatment.
